description: Implementation of the DigitalProductService interface, providing methods to add, retrieve, delete, and save/update digital products associated with products in an e-commerce context. The class manages file handling for digital product downloads, interacts with DAOs and other services, and enforces business rules and transaction boundaries.

classes.name: DigitalProductServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class handling digital product operations including adding files, retrieving by product, deletion, and persistence. Extends a generic service implementation and implements the DigitalProductService interface.

methods.name: addProductFile
methods.description: Adds a digital file to a product, saves the file, marks the product as virtual, and updates the product record.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a digital product entity associated with a specific product and merchant store.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a digital product, removes associated files, and updates the product to not be virtual anymore.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a new digital product or updates an existing one, and marks the associated product as virtual.
